verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe diff review with inline line-by-line comments before merging ("Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge"; "Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything"; "inline code review comments on a diff line by line"), directly matching the review-then-approve-before-PR workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the approval gate actually blocking PR creation, and no explicit mention of an approve/reject UI action distinct from commenting.
